'''Don Kitzman DPC Dan Goes to FreedomCon 2001 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Don Kitzman]] posted on DeckTech on 2 December 2001 about [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="tr-d3133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-dpc-dan-goes-to-freedomcon-2001d3133/ dpc-dan-goes-to-freedomcon-2001], DeckTech (Don "Chef" Kitzman, 2 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-dpc-dan-goes-to-freedomcon-2001d3133/ GitHub Pages].</ref> A short teaser by Don Kitzman for his report on the 2001 World Championship at FreedomCon, [[Don Kitzman DPC Dan Goes to FreedomCon 2001 Complete (tournament report)]], posted the same day.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Don Kitzman]] (byline: Don "Chef" Kitzman)
* '''Published:''' 2 December 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''DPC Dan Goes to FreedomCon 2001''
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Event date:''' 17 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, Virginia

== Original report ==

'''dpc-dan-goes-to-freedomcon-2001'''
* '''Author:''' Don "Chef" Kitzman
* '''Published:''' Dec 2, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  The Further escapade of "DPC Dan" take you into the

deepest part of freedomCon, Exposing the treacherous

dangers of unknown entities.



Explosive! -says Don Kitzman of the Decktech daily times.



Bravo, Charming, and engaging. -Chef, Decktech Weekly.
</nowiki></div>
